summary:
Implementation plan for re-applying the Sage Sanctuary Palette and Button Styling to the native Android Jetpack Compose app:
1. Harmonize Color.kt and Theme.kt with exact Sage Sanctuary color tokens for both Light and Dark themes.
2. Standardize primary action buttons across all dialogs and screens to use Forest Sage (#2D6A4F in light / #3D7D62 in dark) with white text, 12dp rounded corners, and semi-bold typography.
3. Configure all Floating Action Buttons (FABs) across screens to use Warm Amber (#E5A93C) with charcoal #121413 iconography and soft amber elevation shadow.
4. Replace raw hardcoded orange/indigo colors across screens with semantic theme tokens.
